posts.preview: Phase 1 of the parliamentary oversight on compliance with labour legislation in the retail and wholesale sector has concluded in the Ohangwena and Oshana regions

The oversight, conducted by the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations, assessed whether businesses in the sector are complying with Namibia’s labour laws
The committee will continue its investigations in August in the Kavango East, Zambezi and Erongo regions, before concluding the exercise in the Khomas Region in September

One of the notable engagements during the oversight was at All Purpose Wholesale Chinese Shop in Oshakati, where the committee held an interesting discussion with management on the company’s approach to overtime and how overtime work is managed
